note: Era cards from the Timeframe mockup. TOS copy is the text on that mockup. The other eras' summary, overview, and characteristics are project-authored screen text, not rulebook mechanics. campaignStart and campaignEnd are the Campaign Year control only. throughYear is the last year used to decide which spaceframes have launched (Core p. 193). It is not a campaign year the player picked. It is also the year of play used to count refits (Core p. 217).

eras.name: The Original Series
eras.summary: The 2260s and 2270s are a time of exploration and expanding influence for the United Federation of Planets. Starfleet vessels push into uncharted space, establish first contact with new worlds, and defend the Federation's interests along its borders.
eras.overview: Starfleet is a smaller, leaner organization, with a focus on exploration, diplomacy, and scientific discovery. Ships of this era are iconic, versatile vessels designed for long-range missions and independent operations.
characteristics: Technology level appropriate to the 23rd century
Emphasis on scientific and diplomatic missions

eras.name: The Motion Picture Era
eras.summary: A period of technological advancement and expanding Federation influence. Starfleet introduces refitted starships, improved propulsion systems, and more sophisticated exploration vessels. Crews undertake ambitious deep-space missions while navigating rising tensions with the Klingon Empire and the emergence of new interstellar threats.
eras.overview: A period of technological advancement and expanding Federation influence. Starfleet introduces refitted starships, improved propulsion systems, and more sophisticated exploration vessels.
characteristics: Major starship refits and technological modernization
Improved propulsion, shields, and weapon systems
Klingon tensions and emerging interstellar threats

eras.name: The Next Generation Era
eras.summary: An era of exploration, diplomacy, and scientific discovery. Starfleet operates advanced vessels designed for extended missions, with families and civilian specialists serving alongside officers. The Federation expands its understanding of the galaxy while confronting powerful new civilizations and threats, including the Borg.
eras.overview: An era of exploration, diplomacy, and scientific discovery. Starfleet operates advanced vessels designed for extended missions, with families and civilian specialists serving alongside officers.
characteristics: Encounters with the Borg and new civilizations

eras.name: Deep Space Nine Era
eras.summary: A turbulent period of political instability and interstellar conflict. Starfleet shifts from peaceful exploration toward defense and strategic operations as tensions escalate into the Dominion War. Crews face difficult moral choices, shifting alliances, and increasingly dangerous missions along the Federation's borders.
eras.overview: A turbulent period of political instability and interstellar conflict. Starfleet shifts from peaceful exploration toward defense and strategic operations as tensions escalate into the Dominion War.
characteristics: Dominion War and large-scale fleet operations

eras.name: Voyager Era
eras.summary: An era of exploration beyond familiar Federation space. Advanced starships incorporate new technologies while Starfleet confronts the challenges of distant regions and unfamiliar civilizations. Missions emphasize adaptability, resourcefulness, and survival, particularly for crews operating far from Federation support.

characteristics: Exploration of distant and unfamiliar regions
